temporal_rules.note: Future milestone must remain scheduled until official completion.
Draft London Plan content is not current adopted policy.
Inspector report alone does not prove adoption.
Call-for-sites submission is not an allocation.
Housing programme is an area-level delivery proxy.
Register context needs exact polygon/point binding.
Layer title does not prove current effective date.
Current adopted and emerging policy states remain distinct.

score_gates.note: Positive response raw body and SHA-256 required.
Positive growth and constraint intersections must be reconciled.
Indicative regional boundaries cannot directly score a parcel.
Zero result applies only to that query/dataset.
Effective/adoption date required before policy weighting.
Unbound row remains null score, zero confidence and NO_DATA.

crosschecks.note: Compare layer inventory with current adopted/emerging plan status.
Brownfield candidacy and permission status must remain distinct.
Authority delivery evidence is not exact point evidence.
Regional strategy requires local-plan and site-level confirmation.
Growth and constraint layers require exact conflict resolution.
Metadata availability cannot substitute for an exact query response.

system_validations.note: All external hosts are official government, council, GLA or Planning Data hosts.
URL/body SHA-256, UTC, HTTP, content type and raw body are required.
Draft, emerging, scheduled and adopted states remain distinct.
No exact binding or score is emitted.
No new runner or global task replacement is created.
No fabricated live result or business row.
